newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Humpuss condensate splitter to delay start up.
newsitem.headline: Humpuss condensate splitter to delay start up.

text.p: Indonesia's 70,000 barrelS-per-day condensate splitter owned by Humpuss has delayed its start up to end July from this week, an industry source said.
Humpuss planned to run tests this week, but they were postponed due to technical delays.
The splitter is situated close to the 70,000 bpd Arun condensate field owned by US oil major Mobil Corp and Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina.
The splitter will Arun condensate on term from the two companies.
In exchange, Mobil will receive heavy naphtha produced from the splitter.
But the volumes have not been confirmed yet, said the source.
Exports of Arun condensate from Indonesia have fallen sharply since May, due to preparations for the start up of the splitter.
Pertamina did not make any export allocations of Arun condensate to its affilaites in June and July, as part of its plans to get the splitter going.
